boundary_conditions: -(dirt_penetration_depth * erosion_rate / domain_depth) * dc_dx(0) = deposition_flux - wash_off_velocity * c(0)

parameters.name: domain_depth
parameters.justification: Modelled surface layer depth (x = z/domain_depth, x=0 is the eroding surface); 10 dirt penetration depths so that c(1)=0 holds.

parameters.name: deposition_flux
parameters.justification: Deposition of light-absorbing fines (soot, organics, dark mineral dust) ~1.7 mg/m2/day in a hot, dusty city; the same for design and baseline.

parameters.name: wash_off_velocity
parameters.justification: Removal of surface dirt by rain and wind expressed as a surface velocity: k_w/dirt_penetration_depth ~ 1/year in a semi-arid climate.

parameters.name: dirt_absorption_coefficient
parameters.justification: Solar absorptance added per areal load of absorbing dirt (m2/kg), calibrated so that the conventional acrylic coating reaches the CRRC-type aged loss of 0.18 (0.85 -> 0.67).

parameters.name: solar_irradiance_daily_mean
parameters.justification: Clear hot-climate summer day on a roof, ~7 kWh/m2/day.

parameters.name: net_sky_longwave
parameters.justification: Net longwave loss at ambient under dry clear sky.
